title: Evaluation contracts, populations and estimands
outcome: Define which population, unit, loss and decision an evaluation estimates, and demonstrate why a different denominator can reverse its conclusion.

exercises.title: Reverse the comparison
exercises.task: Compute B minus A and then A minus B for one success gained by B.
exercises.hint: Write the sign convention next to the subtraction.
exercises.answer: An improvement sign is a convention. Correctness B minus A favors B when positive; swapping systems negates the result.

exercises.title: Change the target mix
exercises.task: Reweight the worked families to 75% metrics and 25% policy.
exercises.answer: 0.75(1)+0.25(-1)=0.5. The weights describe the target population, not a correction that is always preferable.

exercises.title: Duplicate an identifier
exercises.task: Append an existing request with the same ID.
exercises.hint: The number of rows must equal the number of unique IDs.
exercises.answer: Counting an accidental duplicate twice changes both weights and apparent precision; reject it before estimation.

exercises.title: Require complete gates
exercises.task: Omit the access-policy result from an otherwise favorable packet.
exercises.hint: Check the required field set as well as values.
exercises.answer: An absent result is unknown. Explicit completeness prevents an all([]) or missing-key success.

exercises.title: Show missing-label coverage
exercises.task: Add a second unjudged row to case B.
exercises.expected: Observed accuracy stays 1 while label coverage falls to 0.5.
exercises.hint: Keep eligibility and judged denominators separately.
exercises.answer: The unchanged accuracy does not imply unchanged evidence. Half the eligible population now lacks labels.

exercises.title: Define an empty population
exercises.expected: Raise an error instead of returning perfect accuracy.
exercises.hint: A zero denominator is not a high score.
exercises.answer: An empty evaluation cannot support a deployment claim; the program rejects it and the report should identify why coverage is empty.
